sam: Uploading pen-test + external vuln-scan bundle for CustCorp vendor review. Need remediation owners + ETAs so sales can get RiskOps signoff. S3: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/custcorp/2060012345/ SHA256: 3b9f1c9a7d5e6f2a8c4d9e1b2f3a4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b

lara: Thanks — pinging security and legal. Are raw Nessus/Burp projects included or only a CSV? Legal flagged screenshots with creds as sensitive.

sam: Included raw_nessus.xml, burp_project.json, findings.csv. I removed obvious emails from images but left traces. Will redacted copy if needed.

kevin: I'll triage the high/critical items. Top critical appears to be SSRF in image proxy (see findings.csv repro). Assigning ticket RW-4590.

anna-sre: Taking SSRF (image-proxy). Plan: outbound egress whitelist + strict URL parse + unit test to block metadata endpoints. ETA PR: ~36h.

ben: Noted several medium findings are outdated libs — plan to rebuild images and run fresh scans. I'll post results here.

sam: Customer asked for a one-page remediation timeline (owners, PR links, expected close dates). Need by tomorrow noon. Who can draft?

kevin: I'll draft the timeline and attach to RW-4590 within a few hours.

lara: Reminder: do not share raw screenshots with credentials externally. Sam, please confirm redacted folder before we handoff.

sam: Will upload redacted evidence to s3://redwood-sec-evidence/custcorp/2060012345/redacted/ and confirm here. Thanks team. :pray:
